Select distinct chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles for molecules linked to document CHEMBL1142695. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id, then to compound_structures on molregno. Filter docs by chembl_id CHEMBL1142695 and require canonical_smiles to be non-null. Sort rows by chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles.
